name: heart
clip: refclips/heart.mp4 (480x640, 15 fps, 12.0 s); reference frame 11.6 s
method: Stream foot picked by eye on native-resolution camera crops (2-3x zoom, pixel ticks) and mapped to the M frame with video_extract.image_to_cup on the extractor's per-frame liquid-surface ellipse (track_ell, rot -125 deg, (x,y)_M = (x,-y)_T); cross-checked on rectified M-frame tiles (tiles/zoom_*.png, the stream column projects as a strip toward (-0.85, +0.52) from its foot). Quality-0 frames (cup tilted, t < 3.6 s) use hand-fitted liquid ellipses instead of the propagated track, which includes the far inner wall. Heights from the visible stream length (camera elevation ~48 deg, 32 px/cm), flows from the stream width at the foot and v = sqrt(v0^2 + 2 g z); both +-50 %. Instructor overlay at 5.3-6.6 s: B = (-0.11, +0.19), C = (-0.05, -0.03), D = (0.00, -0.28) in M. No wiggle anywhere in this clip.

stages.note: 在B点注入流量: thick stream lands on the instructor's B dot; clip starts mid-pour (true onset <= 0 s, so first-white delays are lower bounds); cup tilted ~15-25 deg toward the pitcher; position from a hand-fitted liquid ellipse at 0.4 s ((255,326,108,64) px), the propagated track would give (0.05, 0.00); the overlay dot hides the foot until 1.07 s

同时回正杯子 (cup righted while pouring, 0.9-2.5 s); the stream stays fixed in the image while the cup turns, so in surface coordinates the impact moves toward the centre (hand-fit 2.0 s: (0.015, 0.04); propagated track 1.4-2.0 s: (0.07..0.12, -0.05)); first white visible at the foot at 1.07 s (a pale bulb ~0.05 D as soon as the overlay disappears), 0.08 D crescent at 1.33 s

white C-shaped disc grows around/away from the impact, open side toward the spout; impact ~(0, 0.06) relative to the levelled surface (2.6 s (0.05, 0.04), 3.2 s (0.00, 0.09), 3.6 s (-0.04, 0.07); one hand-fit at 2.8 s gives (-0.01, 0.14)); ellipse quality 0 until 3.6 s

奶泡形成半圆形后: the stream stays fixed in the image while the cup is moved ~25 px away from it, so the impact drifts back toward B by ~0.1 D (4.2 s (-0.06, 0.11), 4.8 s (-0.08, 0.16)); the disc's far (D-side) edge stays at y = -0.33, the B-side edge follows the impact
held at B (overlay B/C/D shown 5.3-6.6 s; the foot sits on the B dot); thick stream (~0.06 D wide at the foot), spout ~1.5-2 cm above the surface; brown hole/curl just on the +x side of the foot
向中心点慢慢的移动拉花缸: pitcher moves B -> C slowly (~0.12 D/s), still low and thick; the brown hole at B is left behind as the heart's notch

最后变小流量拉高收尾 (subtitle from 6.8 s): spout raised (stream length ~2.3 cm at 7.2 s, ~3.6 cm at 8.0 s), stream thins (foot width ~15 px at 7.2 s, ~9 px at 8.0 s); the impact keeps moving through C toward D at ~0.17 D/s and draws a faint brown line inside the white
cut: thin stream (~0.03 D) crosses the D half of the disc and reaches the heart tip at 8.6 s (fastest part, ~0.3-0.45 D/s); the spout is ~3.5 cm above the surface (not 7-9 cm)
stem: the thin stream lingers at the tip and is dragged slowly (~0.1 D/s) to the D rim; stream visible until 9.67 s, gone at 9.80 s
pitcher removed (9.8-10.0 s); cup shown, pattern settles; reference frame (targets/heart.npz) at 11.6 s
